title.en: Chapter 15 — The Law of the City

book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: After a year, my wife fell ill and died.
The people came and dressed me in black clothes.
They said to me: we have an old law.

sentences.ar: لما بيموت واحد، بينزل معه شريكه.
sentences.en: When one dies, their partner goes down with them.
They lowered me into a cave under the ground.

sentences.ar: أعطوني خبز ومي لكم يوم بس.
sentences.en: They gave me bread and water for a few days only.
The darkness was heavy and the smell was hard.
